tasks.commitBody:
An MCP server for the rights model, as commissioned: a VIEW, never a second home. A build-time generator reads docs/architecture/entu-rights-and-visibility-model.md plus the source commit SHA and emits a gitignored rules bundle; rights_rule(id) serves one rule verbatim with its evidence and probe paths, rights_rules(topic) serves matching identifiers, and every response — including empty ones and health — carries the source commit so a stale answer is detectable rather than merely plausible. Minimal JSON-RPC/MCP dispatch and a thin CF Worker fetch entry, pure-node tested; no new runtime dependencies; no auth layer per mitselek's on-issue ruling.

Deployment is deliberately NOT part of this change: wrangler.jsonc and a runbook land here, but activation at mvox.eu (and the path-vs-subdomain routing choice) is a production deployment and waits on explicit PO authorization. #318 therefore stays open at this merge and closes when the server is live.

Part of #316.

tasks.commitBody:
#329 built the reader's unknown state but its flag only ever arrived from editor-gated reads (worksManage?.pickableEditionsPartial / libraryEditionsPartial), so the branch could not fire for the audience it names: a rights-less reader whose pinned edition fell past a truncated collective read was still told 'No pinned edition'.

loadWorksByEventId already computed the read's truncated flag and discarded it. It now rides each work row as an optional field — no new reads — and RepertoireElement's reader branch is fed from the row while the editor branch keeps its prop feed byte-identical. The workRows comment that defended the discard is corrected: '' degrades to a harmless blank for name/composer but renders as a positive absence claim for edition. Secondary (issue item 4): a pin that nothing can name is no longer reported as absent under a complete read either — the partial precondition now applies only to the zero-options shape that needs it.

Acceptance is page-level on both the agenda and event pages per Gama's ruling (comment 5635682393); the component-level reader test that was green with the defect intact is untouched and now certified by wiring.

Closes #331
